description: Instituto Superior Técnico and INESC-ID document a RiverCure hindcast of the February 2016 flood at Águeda, Portugal. The public context lists flood-hindcast events beginning on 8 February 2016. Associated HydroShare material combines topography, bathymetry, hydrometric observations and calibrated shallow-water-model results, with repository coverage from 8 to 16 February. The case uses RiverCure and HiSTAV to organise and reconstruct an event where observations near the city are incomplete. Public documentation is free to read; its reuse licence is not stated, while the associated dataset is CC-BY-4.0. Running portal simulations requires registration, which was not needed for this metadata review. A limitation is that simulated quantities fill measurement gaps, so they are not independent observations for validating another model. The case offers a documented benchmark for urban river-flood simulation. It complements the dataset record by identifying the actual application and modelling system, without claiming a measured reduction in flood losses.
